706510201.text: However, they are very difficult to work with. If you want to make anything with them, you'll have to expend a significant amount of other resources as well.

706510202.text: Still, I've just come back from a trip outside, and it seems that most of the ore veins have already been mined. If you go out now, I doubt you'll get anything.

706510203.text: Hmm, how about this? Come find me later, and I'll mark all the veins I know of on your map.

706510101.text: Drat. Running out of ores, are we...

706510102.text: Can I ask you some questions about finding ores?

706510103.text: Ores? What do you want to forge? Weapons or armor?

706510104.text: If you're looking to mine ores, I do know some good spots.

706510105.text: There are all sorts of ores, though. Iron Chunks are the most common, followed by White Iron Chunks, and then Crystal Chunks...

706510106.text: And there's Magical Crystal Chunks, which are of very fine quality, and can be used to forge excellent items.

706510301.text: Hmm, how about this — I'll mark the locations of all the veins I know of on your map.

706510302.text: If you need anything, go and mine it yourself. If you forget where they were, you can come and ask me again.

706510303.text: That said, you'll probably learn them by heart after you go mining a few times.

706510401.text: Magical Crystal Chunks are very hard to mine, however... Hmm, how about this — I'll mark all the positions I know of on your map.

706510402.text: If you can't find any Magical Crystal Chunks, Crystal Chunks should make a good compromise.

706510403.text: Alright then, I've marked your map for you. If you need any ores, go mine them yourself. If you forget their positions, you can come and ask me again.

706510404.text: That said, you'll probably learn them by heart after you go mining a few times.
